additional_info.subject: ID0380212-DC/Si-D/IL[Several] - Charger availability CRM:00315001798
additional_info.body:
Hi Orel,
I performed a quick analysis since I don't think there is any problem with the charger since the customer is only reporting OCPP downtime.
From the photos below you can see that one parameter saying “No Signal” these might be the worst ones, this first one on top seems to be the most reliable one but you can see in the 2nd photo that it's changing to 3G. This can be a problem depending on the region or if 3G is already sort of absolete in your country.
I can only say that there are 2 possibilities:
Signal quality
Slow internet speed
You can always try an external antenna to see if it improves the connection. I've seen several regions try it. Maybe you can ask in the Teams channel Product Sicharge D about it since I cannot provide any experience.
I will wait for your feedback.
